name: Stems
about: Splits a recording into stems: vocals, drums, bass, guitar, keys — on the device, offline.
heavy.desc: Splits any library recording into stems: vocals and instrumental, or vocals, drums, bass and other, or guitar and keys as well. A backing track without the voice, one part on its own — for practice, the player and the studio. HTDemucs models, 235 MB, run on the device. Stems absent from the recording are not produced.
empty: No recordings in the library. Record in the voice recorder or looper, or add a file in the library.
done.title: Separated
mode.title: Stems
mode.hint.6: Vocals, drums, bass, guitar, keys, other — 1.5× longer; guitar and keys separate more roughly.
absent: Not in the recording: {list} — such stems are not saved.
est: Takes about {t}. The screen may go off, but keep the app in front.
saved: Done: stems are in the library
err.load: The model did not load. In the web version this module is unavailable.
help.what: Stems: any library recording → vocals, drums, bass, guitar, keys, other.
help.1: How many stems — 2, 4 or 6. Tap a recording to split. Stems land in the library next to the source; no empty ones.
help.2: In the library player a recording with stems has its own mixer: drop the voice, keep the bass, with key and speed. “Open in studio” — a project from the stems.
help.3: Runs on the device, a few minutes per song; not in the web version.
